No reviewer quorum: full bounty refund and full worker-bond unlock without slash.
ascension.enterprise_role: Executing agent only; no reviewer or MARK reserve receipt is assumed.

jobs_v0.enterprise_role: Worker only; FeePool/validator/treasury allocations excluded from provider receipts.

realization_rules.worker_earnings: Customer-funded net worker award only; returned stake and unrelated beneficiaries are not revenue.
realization_rules.agialpha: Quoted token units times illustrative quoteUSD times adverse/neutral value fraction times(1-slippage)times(1-conversion fee). No appreciation.
realization_rules.usdc: Net workerUSDC times assumedUSD realization times(1-conversion fee). No automatic AGIALPHA purchase/burn.
realization_rules.liquidity: Monthly realized cash is min(nonnegative conversion value, stated cash-conversion limit); remaining asset units are unconverted inventory, not spendableUSD.
realization_rules.gas: Deduct the allowance for every successful settlement even when conversion liquidity is zero; negative cash-after-gas is a funding gap.
realization_rules.collateral: Required open positions=ceil(monthly accepted settlements*lockdays/30). Worker bond stock is separate from earnings; report admission floor separately. Capital cost is imputed, not a modeled cash loan or transaction.
realization_rules.capital_cost: QuotedUSD collateral stock*annual assumed capital-cost rate*30/365; no appreciation or returned principal counted as earnings.
realization_rules.net_result_scope: Settlement proceeds before enterprise delivery, setup, review, overhead, tax and reserves; not profit or automatically reinvestable surplus.
